description: Oracle Exadata engineered systems telemetry covering Storage Cell alert and syslog, DB node syslog/auditd, ILOM hardware events, InfiniBand/management switch syslog, ExaWatcher metric bundles, ExaChk reports, ASR events, and OCI Audit for Exadata service actions. Typical forwarding: syslog/rsyslog relay from cell and compute nodes; ILOM syslog or SNMP trap relay; file-beat from log directories; OCI Logging API pull. Source-shape acquisition is blocked; no relay envelope selected and no validated parser exists yet. Operator action required: provide fixture events before this source can be promoted.

pack_variants.label: Storage cell alerts
pack_variants.description: Storage cell alerts: CellCLI alert history/export, cell alert files.
known_limitations: 2026-07-03 evidence: ALERTHISTORY attributes (alertSequenceID, alertType, severity, alertMessage, metricObjectName, examinedBy, beginTime/endTime) and timestamp formats are documented, but Oracle documents SMTP/SNMP-trap/file-tail delivery and no native single-line syslog wire format for the alert object.
Strong-partial: a fixture is feasible but must declare its delivery-channel assumption (file-tail record vs SNMP-trap-derived record) explicitly before any parser is built.
No parser fixture, SC4S replay, Splunk read-back, or field validation has been captured.

pack_variants.label: Storage cell syslog
pack_variants.description: Storage cell syslog: cell syslog/rsyslog relay.
known_limitations: 2026-07-03 evidence: cells run Oracle Linux rsyslog (RFC3164/5424) with documented forwarding attributes (syslogconf, syslogInput since 22.1); this is syslog-relayable and the cleanest SC4S path.
Overlaps generic Linux syslog handling; the Exadata-specific value is cell/component identity and cell-service program tags, which still need a captured sample to lock.
Blocked from deployable promotion until a representative sanitised cell syslog line and replay/read-back exist.

pack_variants.label: DB node Oracle Linux syslog
pack_variants.description: DB node Oracle Linux syslog: Oracle Linux syslog/journald/auditd with Exadata metadata.
source_modes: Oracle Linux syslog/journald/auditd with Exadata metadata
known_limitations: 2026-07-03 evidence: DB nodes run Oracle Linux rsyslog (RFC3164/5424); syslog-relayable but largely generic Linux syslog.
Use the Linux syslog/auditd packs for Linux parsing; Exadata-specific metadata (rack/node identity, cell correlation) requires captured examples.
No parser fixture, SC4S replay, Splunk read-back, or field validation has been captured.

pack_variants.label: ILOM / service processor logs
pack_variants.description: ILOM / service processor logs: ILOM syslog/SNMP/hardware event export.
known_limitations: 2026-07-03 evidence: ILOM syslog forwarding carries the local event-log fields (Class, Type, Severity, Description, timestamp), but Oracle does not publish the exact wire format (RFC3164 vs 5424, program/tag, timestamp precision/timezone).
Blocked: fields known, wire shape unknown; a captured forwarded sample is required before a parser.
No parser fixture, SC4S replay, Splunk read-back, or field validation has been captured.

pack_variants.label: RoCE/InfiniBand switch logs
pack_variants.description: RoCE/InfiniBand switch logs: switch syslog/SNMP relay.
known_limitations: 2026-07-03 evidence: X8M+ uses Cisco Nexus 9336C-FX2 (NX-OS) and pre-X8M uses Sun/Oracle InfiniBand switches (ILOM); the Exadata configuration procedure sets up no logging host, so any parser would rely on generic NX-OS/ILOM syslog assumptions, not Exadata evidence.
Blocked: generation-dependent and no Exadata-specific emitted-log format is documented.
No parser fixture, SC4S replay, Splunk read-back, or field validation has been captured.

pack_variants.label: ExaWatcher / OSWatcher telemetry
pack_variants.description: ExaWatcher / OSWatcher telemetry: metric/report bundle outputs.
known_limitations: 2026-07-03 evidence: ExaWatcher/OSWatcher samples OS tools and cellsrvstat into bzip2 archive bundles (timestamp in filename), extracted offline via GetExaWatcherResults.sh; it is a diagnostic archive, not a live line stream.
Catalogue-only: not onboardable as an event source without a batch/archive collector; no line-oriented relay exists.
No parser fixture, SC4S replay, Splunk read-back, or field validation has been captured.

pack_variants.label: EXAchk / ORAchk findings
known_limitations: 2026-07-03 evidence: EXAchk/ORAchk (AHF) produces a periodic report bundle per run (HTML primary, optional JSON/XML, named exachk_<host>_<db>_<date>_<timestamp>.html); there is no line-oriented event stream.
Catalogue-only: JSON output could feed a future batch/API pull but is not a syslog source; a redistributable schema/sample is required.
No parser fixture, SC4S replay, Splunk read-back, or field validation has been captured.

pack_variants.label: Auto Service Request events
pack_variants.description: Auto Service Request events: ASR API/email/export relay.
known_limitations: 2026-07-03 evidence: ASR is fed by SNMP traps (SUN-HW-TRAP-MIB varbinds such as sunHwTrapSuspectComponentName, sunHwTrapFaultClass, sunHwTrapFaultMessageID) to an ASR Manager; this is structured SNMP, not a syslog line, and the ASR->Oracle leg is a closed API/email path.
Blocked/out-of-band: an SNMP-trap collector (not syslog) would be required, and the onward leg is not customer-onboardable.
No parser fixture, SC4S replay, Splunk read-back, or field validation has been captured.

pack_variants.label: Exadata Cloud OCI Audit
pack_variants.description: Exadata Cloud OCI Audit: OCI Audit/Logging JSON for Exadata service actions.
source_modes: OCI Audit/Logging JSON for Exadata service actions
known_limitations: 2026-07-03 evidence: OCI Audit / Exadata Database Service on Cloud@Customer emit CloudEvents 0.1 JSON (eventType com.oraclecloud.databaseservice.*, eventTime RFC3339 UTC, data.identity/request/response) via API/Logging/Service Connector.
Overlaps generic OCI audit coverage (packs/oracle_oci); the Exadata-specific angle is the databaseservice eventType vocabulary.
Use generic OCI Audit until Exadata-specific payload examples and read-back exist.
